issues.title: Plumbline drift
issues.body:
Plumbline watch found drift since `plumbline.lock.json` was written.

| Severity | Kind | Ref | What |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| warn | grounding | larch_house.network.json | A grounding source changed since the lock was written; the agent now answers from different facts. |
| warn | grounding | rooms.html | A grounding source changed since the lock was written; all 5 facts the network states from it are still on it. |

`block` means a vendored runtime file, a peer's definition or a peer's links.json changed: look before the next release. After reviewing a change you accept, in a clone of xkazm04/plumbline at the commit this workflow pins, run `node dist/cli/index.js watch --root <path to your site> --relock`, sign the site again (the lock is a signed file) and commit both. The next clean run closes this issue.

A clean report does not mean the site is safe: it means the locked files, peers and runtime match what was locked.

<!-- plumbline:digest [["warn","grounding","larch_house.network.json"],["warn","grounding","rooms.html"]] -->

prs.body:
Plumbline watch found drift as of https://github.com/larchhouse/larchhouse-site/actions/runs/w1-relockpr-at-raise, and this pull request accepts it: `plumbline watch --relock` rewrote `plumbline.lock.json` from the current state.

**What the new lock changes:**

- changed `grounding rooms.html`

**The findings this accepts** (review each before merging; a `block` is changed code):

| Severity | Kind | Ref | What |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| warn | grounding | rooms.html | A grounding source changed since the lock was written; all 5 facts the network states from it are still on it. |

**Not signed.** The lock is a signed file, so the site's signature reads invalid (tampered) until it is signed again. Check out this branch, run `plumbline sign` with your key, push, and mark this pull request ready. It stays a draft until then.

Nothing is accepted until a person merges this. A clean watch closes it.
